chunks: And in it is that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorified, did not grant Satan authority over the believers except over those who follow him.
And He made for them partners in it to mislead them from what was brought to them.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over believers according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this verse within the Shia doctrine of *al-Ilm al-Ilahi* and the infallibility of the Imams, highlighting that Satan's 'partners' are the false guides and corrupt scholars who lead the masses astray. This conditional authority underscores the believer's agency; while Satan has power over those who submit to his whispers, the *Awliya' Allah* (Friends of God) remain immune through their conscious adherence to divine truth.
